about: Taylor's phase gate, the half of 'is this agent switched on' that is his to decide.
Blueprint s.11: each phase is approved by Taylor before it is built. An agent runs only
when its phase is approved and Mike has built and accepted it (build_record in
context/roster-agents.json). scripts/team.py combines the two; the dispatch gate
(.claude/hooks/require-active-agent.py), the doctor and the contract validator all read it.
UPSTREAM DEFAULTS ONLY: Phase 1 approved, Phase 6 deferred, nothing else decided. Taylor's
own decisions live in state/taylor/phases.json (scripts/overlay.py), untracked, and win
over this file, so a `git pull` never fights them. They change only when his own latest
message says the approval phrase in CLAUDE.md: the orchestrator sets approved to true and
approved_at there, and appends one bullet to state/taylor/CHANGE-LOG.md in the same turn.
'resume Phase 6' also sets deferred to false. This file changes only in build mode.
An unreadable or malformed file switches nothing on: team.py raises and the gate refuses.

1.name: People and management actions
1.basis: Counted as approved and built for this build (Mike, 2026-10-01). Taylor's written answers on D-1 and D-2 are recorded separately, and D-1 still gates every write to a live Doc.
